name: tether-mail
description: Triages new Tether mailbox mail (read / fyi / action / human) so agent chatter stays out of the chat: action mail goes to a background claude -p sidecar for the seat, human mail to a toast and band, FYIs to a pane and band; at most a one-line pointer reaches the chat.

pollSeconds.title: Poll seconds
pollSeconds.description: Poll interval in seconds when push is unavailable (default 20)

cli.title: Tether CLI
cli.description: Command used to reach the hub (default tether-remote)

triageModel.title: Triage model
triageModel.description: Model for the side triage call when a message carries no attention field (default haiku)
